platform_info.name: Netflix
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. Supports multi-profile DDPs; the participant selects their profile at runtime. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: Your ratings on Netflix. These preferences help Netflix learn what you like and influence the recommendations you receive.
description.nl: Uw beoordelingen op Netflix. Deze voorkeuren helpen Netflix te leren wat u leuk vindt en beïnvloeden de aanbevelingen die u ontvangt.

title.nl: Beoordeelde titels op basis van duimpjes

documentation.summary: Each row represents one title the participant rated on Netflix, including the rating value and timestamp.

columns.Title Name: Name of the rated Netflix title.
columns.Thumbs Value: Thumbs up or thumbs down value given by the participant.
columns.Event Utc Ts: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the rating was given.

description.en: This table shows what you watched, when, for how long, and on what device. It paints a detailed picture of your Netflix viewing habits.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont wat u heeft gekeken, wanneer, hoe lang en op welk apparaat. Het geeft een gedetailleerd beeld van uw Netflix-kijkgedrag.

title.nl: Totaal aantal uren gekeken per maand

title.en: Total hours watched by hour of the day
title.nl: Totaal aantal uur gekeken per uur van de dag

documentation.summary: Each row represents one viewing session on Netflix, including the title watched, start time, and duration in hours.

columns.Start Time: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the viewing session started.
columns.Duration: Duration of the viewing session in hours.
columns.Title: Name of the Netflix title watched.
columns.Supplemental Video Type: Type of supplemental video (e.g. trailer), if applicable.

description.en: Your search history on Netflix. This reveals what you were looking for, even titles you searched for but never watched.
description.nl: Uw zoekgeschiedenis op Netflix. Dit onthult wat u zocht, zelfs titels die u heeft opgezocht maar nooit heeft gekeken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one search the participant performed on Netflix.

columns.Query Typed: The search query the participant typed.
columns.Displayed Name: The result title that was displayed.
columns.Utc Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was performed.
